scope: Read-only review of current ordinary instructions, every agent-image source/configuration file and calibration-data schema for thermal-bodies, reaction-diffusion, qubit-control and magnetic-tracer. Private references and tests were read only to identify unearned clues or grading restrictions. Deliberately appended hints are assessed separately.

summary.conclusion: The ordinary public surfaces do not expose true parameters, hidden cases, the corrective equations or a required solver. Necessary apparatus facts should remain. Clarifying that all implementation code may be changed would avoid an accidental fit-only reading.

findings.confidence: high on wording; no claim that it caused any observed failure
findings.finding: Each instruction says Complete while fit is the only unfinished method and predict is already implemented. An agent can reasonably read this as filling fit while retaining the supplied model form. No text actually forbids predictor changes, so this is an implicit scope ambiguity rather than an explicit algorithm mandate.

findings.rationale: This grants implementation freedom without saying which supplied assumption is wrong, naming a missing term or requiring a particular representation. Apply uniformly rather than only to tasks with a known modeling trap.

findings.finding: The helper name _binary labels the supplied propagator as a binary-system approximation even though the apparatus contains two salts and three ions. This is a small implementation-name clue to the calibration limitation; it does not reveal the common-field correction.

evidence.evidence_text: Rigid sealed total volume; freely moving adiabatic unloaded piston; fast mechanical equilibration; known heat paths and no external work.

necessary_apparatus_facts_to_keep.why_necessary: These specify the mechanical constraint and heat/work bookkeeping. Removing pressure equilibration or fixed total volume would permit physically different apparatuses. They do not supply the coupled capacity matrix or sum/difference solution. CP in starter model.py:5 and its propagation at19 describes the supplied closure, not a required law or the hidden correction.

evidence.evidence_text: Fully dissociated monovalent salts sharing one anion; ionic diffusion ratios; blocking insulating ends; no applied current; electroneutral bulk observations.
Initial concentrations are known and linear between mesh points; species order and output mesh/time convention.

necessary_apparatus_facts_to_keep.why_necessary: The ionic composition, boundary conditions and bulk limit select the experiment. Electroneutrality identifies the measured approximation; it does not give the common diffusion-potential equation. The interpolation rule defines initial data independently of a numerical solver and avoids ambiguity when refining the mesh.

evidence.evidence_text: Spatially uniform classical longitudinal field with Gaussian white covariance; identical otherwise uncoupled probes; preparation/readout rotations and joint +z detector.

necessary_apparatus_facts_to_keep.why_necessary: The common physical field and joint detector are the apparatus, not optional hints. Omitting uniformity would leave cross-probe noise correlation unspecified. The README gives neither an average-of-products formula nor a collective dephasing generator. Its angular-frequency language is conventional; optional precision is to replace "its component xi(t)" with "the longitudinal spin-precession angular frequency xi(t)" without adding a solution equation.

evidence.evidence_text: Thermal force covariance; Newton equation with drag and Lorentz force; prescribed nonuniform static B; Maxwell initial velocities; strict small-mass limit at fixed positive observation time.
Explicit normalized preparation, detector observable and control ranges; uniform-field calibration including zero.

necessary_apparatus_facts_to_keep.why_necessary: These fix the overdamped limit and measurement rather than mandating a solver. Without the microscopic force law, initial velocity law and limiting order, distinct stochastic prescriptions could be defensible. No Hall mobility, noise-induced drift or corrected density generator is supplied publicly. The calibration regime is an observable property of the data and should not be concealed.

evidence.evidence_text: ThermalModel API, fitted conductance and array/time conventions.

grader_solution_space_review.assessment: No constant-CP, matrix-exponential or ODE requirement is enforced. Analytic sum/difference solutions and coupled heat/work integration are both admissible. Returning the fitted physical parameter and the advertised array shape are explicit task requirements, not accidental model restrictions.

evidence.evidence_text: Physical input interpolation and TransportModel API.
Positive diffusivity, finite arrays and calibration loss.
Private error measures per-species concentration dynamics; no required DCT or finite-volume method.

grader_solution_space_review.assessment: No _binary helper, fixed grid algorithm or independent-species representation is required. The reference uses a finer spatial grid but the output checks accept any method meeting the concentration tolerances. The 5% error on each species is deliberately sensitive to induced transport in an initially uniform species; it does not require a particular solver.
